name.ja: ＭＧ 1/100 ジム・コマンド（宇宙戦仕様）

ja: コ ロ ニ ー の 守 護 者―マスターグレードシリーズでロールアウト！
『機動戦士ガンダム0080 ポケットの中の戦争』から、
ＲＧＭ－７９ＧＳ ジム・コマンド（宇宙戦仕様）をマスターグレードシリーズで商品化。
ランドセル・頭部・胸部装甲等をはじめとした機体形状を、各所新規造形で徹底再現！ビーム・ガンも新たに付属！
● ＭＧ準拠の新規造形で、機体形状を再現！
頭部、胸部装甲、ランドセル等、特徴的な機体形状を新規造形で徹底再現。
【頭部】
頬部分にダクトを備えた、拠点防衛型の機体に特徴的な頭部形状を再現。
【胸部】
胸部装甲部分にダクトが増設された形状を再現。特徴的な赤のカラーは成形色で再現。
【腕部】
前腕部外装、とヒジ部分の外装は新規パーツ。
【ランドセル】
先行量産型ジムと比べ、１３０％に相当する推力を有する、バーニアが増設されたランドセルを新規造形で再現。
【腰部】
中央部分・フロントスカート部分の形状を再現。
【脚部】
すね部分の前側装甲は新規パーツで再現。
● ＭＧジム・スナイパーIIをベースとした、可動機構を搭載！
【BODY】前後のスイング機構と腰部の回転がもたらす“ひねり”の動きにより、人体に近い可動を実現。
【NECK】首関節は取り付け基部が可動し、射撃ポーズ時の動きに対応。
【SHOULDERS】肩関節に引出しと回転の可動軸を設けることで、多様なアクションに対応。
【LEGS＆FEET】脚部フレームは、広範囲な可動を実現。足裏は分割構造により高い接地性を追求。
● 専用武装 ビーム・ガンを新規造形で再現！
コロニーでの短時間の防御戦闘を想定した機体にあわせ、火力が強化された専用装備 ビーム・ガンを新規造形で再現。
そのほかにも、多彩な武器類が付属！
● 新規デザインの水転写式デカール付属！
地球連邦軍のマーキングに加えて、サウス・バニング率いる”不死身の第４小隊”の部隊マーク、
及び第４小隊４名のパーソナルマークを収録。
ＡＣＥ ＰＩＬＯＴ ＬＯＧ　エース・パイロットログ[Ｕ.Ｃ.編]
“エース・パイロット”とＭＳが、宇宙世紀の歴史に刻んだ”ログ（記録）”をたどる、ＷＥＢ企画！
ＶＯＬ.０３“不死身の第４小隊”掲載！
付属武装 ： ビーム・ガン　／　ブルバップ・マシンガン　／　ビーム・サーベル　／ シールド

en: Colony Guardian - Roll out with the Master Grade Series!
From "Mobile Suit Gundam 0080 War in the Pocket",
RGM-79GS GM Command (space battle specification) is commercialized in the Master Grade series.
The shape of the aircraft, including the school bag, head, chest armor, etc., has been thoroughly reproduced with new modeling in various parts! A new beam gun is also included!
● Reproduce the aircraft shape with new MG-compliant modeling!
The characteristic body shape, such as the head, chest armor, and school bag, has been thoroughly reproduced with new modeling.
[head]
Reproduces the characteristic head shape of a base defense type aircraft with ducts on the cheeks.
[Chest]
Reproduces the shape with an additional duct added to the chest armor part. The characteristic red color is reproduced with molded color.
[Arm]
The forearm exterior and elbow exterior are new parts.
[school bag]
Compared to the previous mass-produced gym, the school bag with an added vernier has a thrust equivalent to 130%, and is reproduced with a new model.
[waist]
Reproduce the shape of the center part and front skirt part.
[leg]
The front armor of the shin part is reproduced with new parts.
● Equipped with a movable mechanism based on MG Jim Sniper II!
[BODY] The front and back swing mechanism and the "twisting" movement caused by the rotation of the waist achieve movement similar to that of the human body.
[NECK] The attachment base of the neck joint is movable and corresponds to movement during shooting poses.
[SHOULDERS] A movable axis of drawer and rotation is provided in the shoulder joint to support a variety of actions.
[LEGS & FEET] The leg frame allows a wide range of movement. The sole of the foot has a split structure to achieve high ground contact.
● Reproduce the special armament beam gun with new modeling!
The beam gun, a special equipment with enhanced firepower, has been recreated with a new model to suit the aircraft, which is designed for short-term defensive battles in colonies.
In addition, various weapons are included!
● Newly designed water transfer decal included!
In addition to the markings of the Earth Federation army, the unit markings of the "Immortal 4th Platoon" led by South Banning,
Also includes the personal marks of four members of the 4th Platoon.
ACE PILOT LOG Ace Pilot Log [U.C. edition]
A web project in which “Ace Pilot” and MS trace the “logs” carved into the history of the Universal Century!
VOL.03 “Immortal 4th Platoon” published!
Attached weapons: Beam gun / Bullbop machine gun / Beam saber / Seal
